text: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_pref_name, md.max_phase AS compound_max_phase, md.molecule_type AS compound_molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles AS compound_canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
